reason: The arming plug and flight console are the only available pieces, and the goal explicitly calls for fitting the plug.
expectation: The plug should arm the console and initiate the cleared launch.

effect: The plug armed the launch circuit, and pressing START launched the cabin, completing the goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the repaired landing support and station recede, although the final action was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the arming plug provided a clear payoff: the cabin lifted off while the replacement leg remained behind.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final decision offered only one obvious combination, so it involved little problem-solving.

surprise.text: Nothing in the final action particularly surprised me; the launch followed the visible goal.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the plug had a clear role in arming the flight console.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the specimens reveal on Earth, though I would hope for more meaningful decisions than this final chapter offered.
